title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Results Ledger. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Results Ledger
options.lineage: official MPL season standings & match ledger
options.thesis: A fan hub built as a verified season record: the team's proof is the design.
options.viewport: A near-black standings board fills the fold: NAVI's S18 runner-up row lit in amber, a one-line team statement, the seven-name lineup in one-word roles, and one amber Shop the collection action.
options.risk: Reads like a stats wiki if the roster and shop action do not carry equal weight.

raised.raise: Dated Verdict Stamps — every verified result and title carries a permanent, dated mark.
Lift-on-Select — the active row rises and brightens with a soft amber halo.
Registered Pairing — standings and fixtures sit side by side, stacked under one heading on phones.
The Live Hour — one amber official-record marker keeps the board current, not nostalgic.
The Eleven-Step Ramp — all neutrals come from one fixed tonal scale; amber alone carries signal.
Fixed-Width Figures — every number sits in a tabular slot and cross-fades instead of reflowing.

options.label: The Cut-and-Sew Jersey
options.lineage: cut-and-sew esports jersey & woven neck tag
options.thesis: The team is the shirt every fan wears and shops for.
options.viewport: A full-bleed jersey construction carries the team name; player names run down a woven-tag column; the shop action is stitched into a care label.
options.risk: Also the most obvious alias for a merch-led fan site: a jersey store.

options.label: The Fan Passport
options.lineage: well-traveled passport, stamps and security paper
options.thesis: Every verified result becomes a dated stamp in the fan's record.
options.viewport: A ruled record page holds amber entry stamps; the S18 spread opens to dated results and a merchandise entry slip.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: results and titles map to dated stamps; loses on product clarity because the shop route becomes a receipt.
options.risk: Reads as a travel diary if the team's current facts do not lead.

options.label: The Nixie Counter
options.thesis: The team's record is a bank of glowing, countable figures.
options.viewport: Digit banks hold wins, titles and S18 standing; the roster reads as engraved labels below; one warm count action sits at the edge.
options.case: Fuses on product clarity — numbers become the interface — but loses audience identification: instrument nostalgia is not MLBB fandom.
options.risk: Turns the team into a scoreboard of anonymous metrics.

options.label: The Memory Void
options.lineage: sixth-generation console dashboard in black void
options.thesis: Roster, results and merch drift as glowing objects in a dark room.
options.viewport: Dark rooms of floating, amber-selected objects with sparse labels and generous void.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a void of objects hides the names, figures and shop action fans came for.
options.kept: Lift-on-select becomes a named raise on the assigned direction.

options.label: The Folded Sheet
options.thesis: A single team sheet rises into a rigid display.
options.viewport: One pale sheet folded into a stand with figure-numbered plates and inclined serif labels.
options.case: Fuses poorly: paper craft reads as a design object, not a fan hub.
options.kept: Registered pairing of plan and section becomes a named raise.

options.label: The Night City
options.thesis: The team's city becomes an urban nocturne of light.
options.viewport: Blue-hour skyline, transit veins and reflected lights stacked as synchronized night bands.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the city becomes the subject; the team is a beacon inside it.
options.kept: A single current-hour signal becomes a named raise.

options.label: The Exposure Record
options.thesis: Performance is hatch density over an eleven-step zone ramp.
options.viewport: Translucent hatched sheets over a backlit tonal ramp with one magenta filtration mark.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a darkroom record is not a language this audience identifies with.
options.kept: One strict tonal ramp becomes a named raise.
options.risk: Cold and illegible to a fan.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
